usage: The word '露台' refers to an outdoor balcony attached to a building or house.
'露台' is used as a noun, so it functions as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can describe activities that happen on the balcony, like sitting or watering plants, using '露台'.
To specify the location, you can say things like 廚房旁邊嘅露台 (the balcony next to the kitchen).
It is often used with verbs like '坐' (to sit), '晒' (to sunbathe), '睇' (to look/watch), or '擺放' (to place) when describing actions related to the balcony.
